title: The Seven-Day Slice: First Week in Holdfast
description: The canonical seven-day playtest scenario exercising baseline survival loops: orientation, crafting, weather, injury, bereavement, governance, and deadline resolution.

beats.title: Day 1: Orientation & First Rations
beats.description: Assess starting provisions, assign initial shelter bunks, and distribute day 1 rations.

beats.title: Day 2: Maintenance & First Dispatch
beats.description: Service vital air scrubbers at the workshop bench and dispatch the first scout into the wasteland.

beats.title: Day 3: Weather Threat & Route Selection
beats.description: A fallout squall approaches; player chooses between a sheltered valley detour or exposed ridge advance.

beats.title: Day 4: Hazard Encounter & Field Triage
beats.description: A scout returns with acute radiation exposure; administer rad-away and assign infirmary bed rest.

beats.title: Day 5: Bereavement & Memorial Rites
beats.description: Hold memorial ceremony for fallen survivor; allocate keepsake to survivor legacy archive.

beats.title: Day 6: Policy Decree & Ideological Friction
beats.description: Shelter assembly votes on emergency water rationing decree; handle faction dissent.

beats.title: Day 7: Commitment Settlement & First Week Milestone
beats.description: Settlement of initial community commitment deadline; review weekly scorecard and survivor retention.
